findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_price_alert, get_pricing_export_url, list_conversations, get_cache_stats, import_session_usage, register_budget_alert · Private data: predict_cost, record_usage, analyze_session_usage, import_session_usage · Public sink: register_price_alert, list_price_alerts, get_cache_stats, analyze_session_usage, register_budget_alert, list_budget_alerts · Destructive: delete_price_alert, delete_conversation, get_cache_stats, delete_budget_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_price_alert, get_pricing_export_url, list_conversations, get_cache_stats, import_session_usage, register_budget_alert · Private data: predict_cost, record_usage, analyze_session_usage, import_session_usage · Public sink: register_price_alert, list_price_alerts, get_cache_stats, analyze_session_usage, register_budget_alert, list_budget_alerts · Destructive: delete_price_alert, delete_conversation, get_cache_stats, delete_budget_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
